hedges.reason: The list has no crude oil, tanker or gold instruments. A US naval blockade of Iran, or of Hormuz transits, is the closest match to the Gulf-energy side of my hedge thesis. The mechanism is that renewed Israel-Iran fighting with US involvement brings back Iranian threats to Hormuz. That makes an official US blockade or interdiction announcement one of Washington's likely escalation or containment tools. I use the mild (latest-date) rung because a blockade is a large step that would probably come after the first strikes, not alongside them.

Senior US-Iran talks are running on the roadmap agreed in Switzerland on June 22. In the worlds where my NO basket fails, an Israeli or US strike on Iran has restarted the war, which suspends the diplomatic track. Iran would refuse a new senior round while under attack, as happened after June 2025. That makes 'no qualifying meeting by September 30' more likely exactly in those worlds.
